$comment: Hand-maintained corrections. These win over every automated source.
Keys are model ids ('<provider>/<model>'). Only the fields you list are overridden;
everything else still comes from the aggregated sources.
Set a field to null to explicitly blank it out.
Every entry SHOULD carry `_source` (a link to the provider's own pricing page) and
`_verified` (YYYY-MM-DD). `npm run validate` warns about entries older than 90 days
so this file cannot silently rot into the very problem this repo exists to solve.

hide.$comment: Model ids (or '<provider>/*' globs) to drop from the dataset entirely — dead endpoints, test entries, duplicates.
